info.description: Shared private scan engine for the Tracefold upload app and MCP adapter.

post.description:
Approve a public company identity (requires the `configure` capability). Creates a new immutable version
when `profile_id` is given.

get.description: Approved public identities (latest version of each).

Fixed preset catalog: per-provider templates, status (benchmarked/experimental/legacy), packs, site groups,
noise domains and budget shapes.

post.description:
Create an immutable plan of exact outbound searches from an approved profile, fixed presets, providers and
a public-site scope (requires `configure`).

get.description: Preview the exact outbound queries, providers, domain scope and budget.

Complete source list for a scan, including no-match, failed, blocked and skipped candidates, with
discovery provenance.

ApproveRequest.title: ApproveRequest
ApproveRequest.description:
Approving needs the ``approve`` capability, which only the company's own app token holds. ``approver`` is optional:
without it the action is recorded against that client and takedowns are signed with the company name and reply-to.

confirm_public.title: Confirm Public
confirm_public.description: Confirms this identity is public and may be sent to the selected search providers.

EditActionRequest.title: EditActionRequest
EditActionRequest.description:
Edit an unsent takedown. ``body`` replaces the draft text (ActionOut.draft_body), not the rendered preview:
keep the {company} token and leave the signature off; both are added when the letter is rendered and sent.

PublicDiscoveryIn.title: PublicDiscoveryIn
PublicDiscoveryIn.description: Select an already approved query plan. No company name, query or document-derived field is accepted.

include_experimental.title: Include Experimental
include_experimental.description: Let a pack use presets without a benchmark target yet.

exclude_official_domain.title: Exclude Official Domain
exclude_official_domain.description: Leave the company's own site out of results.

exclude_noise.title: Exclude Noise
exclude_noise.description: Leave the versioned noise-domain list out of results.
